purpose: Carries the per-criterion verification flag (external or testOnly) from rcf-schemas through the rcf-lite writer, rcf define validate and rcf audit coverage, so each criterion and each spec shows the end state it must reach and where it is now.
responsibilities: rcf-schemas user-story.schema.json $defs.acceptanceCriterion.properties.verification: enum external | testOnly, optional at schema level, additionalProperties stays false
the rcf-lite writer carries verification on define create ac (from --from-file, like scope) and define update <AC id> --set verification=<value>
rcf define validate requires the flag on criteria new or amended since a base ref and reports every live criterion without it
rcf audit coverage adds verification, expectedEnd and now per criterion and expectedEnd and now per spec

interfaces.name: AcceptanceCriterion.verification
interfaces.description: fields: verification (string enum external | testOnly; optional at schema level; required by rcf define validate on criteria new or amended since the base). external: observable through the release Verify target (for rcf-lite the packed artefact installed cold); ends at verified. testOnly: observable only by the RCF suite; ends at complete. Absent on a live criterion: reported as unflagged.

interfaces.name: rcf define validate (verification rule)
interfaces.description:
usage: rcf define validate [--base <ref>] [--report verification] [--json]
Exit 0 clean; 3 when a criterion new or amended since the base lacks verification (one "[error] verification AC-x is new|amended since <base7> and carries no verification flag (external | testOnly)" line each). Base: --base <ref>, else the merge-base with origin/main; no base resolvable and no --base: one "[warn] verification: no base ref; new and amended criteria not checked" line and the rule is report-only. --base naming a missing ref: exit 2 "[error] usage --base <ref> does not resolve". --report verification: prints one line per live unflagged criterion "<AC id>\t<US id>\t<FBS id or ->\t<first 80 characters of the description>" then "verification: <k> of <n> live criteria unflagged" and exits 0 whatever k is.

interfaces.name: CoverageRow end-state columns
interfaces.description: fields: per criterion verification (external | testOnly | unflagged), expectedEnd (verified | complete | unknown when unflagged), now (notStarted | inProgress | complete | verified | retired); per spec expectedEnd (verified when any live criterion is external, else complete; unknown when any live criterion is unflagged and none is external) and now (the FBS executionStatus). A criterion now never exceeds its expectedEnd: a testOnly criterion on a verified spec reads complete. Table columns flag, end, now; JSON keys verification, expectedEnd, now; Mermaid unchanged.

interfaces.name: Interim flag tag (WORKAROUND)
interfaces.description: format: a user story tags[] entry "verification:<AC id>=<external|testOnly>", one per criterion on its own story, written by the 0.37.0 DEFINE through rcf define create us and rcf define update. WORKAROUND: rcf-schemas 0.9.0 has no verification field. Root-cause item: the rcf-schemas slice (FBS of REQ-195). Review-by: the 0.37.0 release. Moved onto the field and deleted by the flag slice's DEFINE round.

notes: Read at rcf-lite 639f07bb and rcf-schemas 906b6682 (0.9.0): $defs.acceptanceCriterion is additionalProperties false with no verification property, so no criterion can carry the flag as a field until the pin moves.
name: AC verification flag and end state: the schema field, its writers, validate and coverage
